global_cfg:
[accounts]
auto_switch = true

[[accounts.records]]
id = "work"
name = "work"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
priority = 10

[[accounts.records]]
id = "makers"
name = "makers"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
priority = 20

[[accounts.records]]
id = "cx-a"
name = "cx-a"
harness = "codex"
auth = "managed"
priority = 30

[[accounts.records]]
id = "cx-b"
name = "cx-b"
harness = "codex"
auth = "managed"
priority = 40

[[accounts.records]]
id = "plain"
name = "plain"
harness = "claude"
auth = "oauth_dir"
priority = 50
credentials_source = "{TMP}/creds"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "own"
name = "own"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
priority = 60
config_dir = "{TMP}/own-dir"

expect.stderr: error: 'own' is a config-dir account (its own <TMP>/own-dir); it is spawn-only. Use it per-worker with `fno agents spawn --account own`, not a daemon-wide switch.
